Correct folder

m1  = (-8*10000)/(ln(1-(0.0001)^1/8))
    = -80000/ln(1-0.316227766)
    = -80000/ln(0.683772233)
    = -80000/-0.380130408
    = 210455

c1  = (10000*13*8)/210455
    = 1040000/210455
    = 4.94167399

m2  = -80000/(ln(1-(0.001)^1/8))
    = -80000/ln(1-0.4216965)
    = -80000/ln(0.5783034)
    = -80000/-0.5476564
    = 146077

c2  = 1040000/146077
    = 7.119532
